batting.name: TL Suman
batting.dismissal: c P Kumar b Azhar Mahmood

batting.name: LRPL Taylor
batting.dismissal: c Gurkeerat Singh b P Kumar

batting.name: AD Mathews
batting.dismissal: c AC Gilchrist b P Awana

batting.name: AC Gilchrist
batting.dismissal: c MN Samuels b AD Mathews

balls.text: tries the big sweep again, does not get hold of it, the ball rolls towards the keeper on off, there is an overthrow, long on runs forward, picks it up and hits the stumps at the non-striker's end, and Pune can't reach 100
Nayar bends down and sweeps a low full toss, gets it in the air past square leg's jump
right in the blockhole from Mahmood just outside off, and Nayar can only dig it back
squeezes out  a very full one out to long on
swing and a miss, it is a slower one on off from Mahmood, and off it is that takes a walk
sloppy from PK, should have stopped this, was slogged straight over the bowler, PK got to it from long on, got a hand down to it, but it rolled over in the end
pushed down the pitch to the bowler
backs away and has a go, this bowled slower, and beats him, Gilchrist dives behind to collect
Nayar gets one away, pitched up on the pads, and he lifts it crisply, one bounce over the deep midwicket rope
punched off the back foot to sweeper cover
opened him up, holding its line from back of a length, Bhuvneshwar hops tries to get bat to ball, cannot
throws his bat to a length ball outside off, and is beaten, again lots of bounce for Harris
loopy slower one now, he waits after getting across and turns it to leg
pitched up, turned square from the crease
stays a shade low now, he is back in the crease and jabs it to leg
can;t time the punch from the crease, sharp bounce again, it rolls towards short extra cover
Mahmood puts in a loud and long appeal, but that pitched outside leg before hitting him on the pad from a good length
gets a single now as he dabs a length ball to third man
across on off to have a swing, beaten as it holds its line on the angle
stays on the crease and runs a length ball to third man
back of a length, outside off, he brings it down
beaten right away, as he goes pushing outside off to a pacy length ball
Ryan Harris back, and flattens Marsh's stumps first ball, Marsh has a slog from the crease to a length ball around off, it moves in a bit, and he gets a fatal inside edge
very full and Marsh swings it just past the non-striker's stumps, long off gets around to it
PK taken for more runs, full and wide, Marsh has no problems in reaching out and drilling a drive past a helpless sweeper
and he sprays the next ball wide outside off
that is short, gentle and sitting up, and Marsh sends it  over the deep square leg boundary with a swift swipe
moves across, gets too close to the line, and can;t place the drive too wide of the sweeper
very full, on leg, he's hit this straight, too straight, into the stumps at the other end
walks down the pitch and a flashes at a widish one, can;t connect
back to a length ball straightening on middle, and jabs it to extra cover for one
can;t time the cut at all, underedge rolls past the keeper
gets the boundary this time, bends forward for the sweep and hits it hard through square leg
too close to cut, he backs away and chops it to backward poit
hit on the pad on the forward push, Chawla down on the knee to appeal, Sreesanth style, not given, that was a good shout, hit him on the knee roll on middle, height could have been an issue
bends on the knee and scoops it down to fine leg
mistimes the pull through square leg, but a couple are taken as fine leg runs around
worked to fine leg off the pad

what a blinder at fine leg! Gurkeerat the man, he didn;t have too much time, Taylor had swung this hard off his pads and it looked to be a certain boundary, Gurkeerat ran quickly to his right, the ball would have still beaten him, so he dives full-length, takes it, and does not let it pop out as he crashes back on to earth
heaves a length ball through square leg, no timing at all
straightish length ball on the stumps, pushed down to long on
it hurries on close to off, but he adjusts nicely to chop it to short third man
leg side with the line and knocked into vacant square leg for an easy two
full and flighted delivery pushed out to the sweeper
nudged to the leg side for one
was coming across initially, then sees it is there to be cut, and goes hard at it, but to backward point
beats the bat again does Awana, he's been so disciplined, good length outside off, Taylor goes prodding at it
width available, and the Taylor cut comes out, beating backward point's dive and racing to the rope
shuffles outside off and pushes hard, thick edge runs to third man
beaten again, gets across and tries to drive a length ball going across, can't connect
no width at all, around off on a length, pushed to point
beaten first up with one leaving him with the angle
across with the front pad to turn it square on leg
bends the knee and paddle-scoops it in the air through vacant short fine
flighted slower now, he is forward to ease it to point
rushes straight on now, outside off, chopped to point
not short and wide enough, he backs away and cuts, to point
moves forward and pats a tossed up ball to off

brute, what a brute from Awana, angled in, back of a length, and jags across to open up the right-hander, and Gilchrist celebrates as soon as he takes the ball, not much Angelo could have done with that, except hoping he didn;t edge it
Angelo gets a boundary, skips out, and swats a length ball straight down the ground, not off the middle, but enough on it
goes very full on the stumps now, he gets legs out of the way and digs it out to mid on
good length, punched back down the pitch
that lifts from back of a length, he is up to drop it softly on the off for one
swinging in a tad around off, good length, pushed solidly back to the bowler

gone now, Uthappa eager to leave his crease, this one does not turn, it is a touch flatter, quicker and he is caught in a tangle as he stops, ball squeezes in past the bat to hit the stumps, had no room in the end, could not even attempt to push it away, was in such a bad position
comes down now, not close to the pitch and pushes the flighted ball away
drives a tossed up full delivery but short extra is in the way
comes forward to a flighted ball and pushes to long off
nice, tossed up slowly, draws Taylor forward, and takes the edge past the slip
just outside off stump, pushed to short extra
played out towards point, rushes out for the single, doubles back, in time
short extra times his jump neatly to stop this drive that takes off after being hit hard into the pitch, but he misses with the throw at the non-striker's

on middle now, good length, he waits on the crease and works it through square leg, but hello, what a throw from the deep, right into the captain's gloves inches from the stumps, has Samuels' dive saved him, nope, it hasn't, perfect throw really, Gilly didn't have to move an inch
clipped off the pad to deep midwicket
superb, holding its line around off stump and zooming past the edge from a length, got to like the look of this attack
that nips in from back of a length, cramping him, and is squeezed out to point
pitched up, driven into the pitch and straight to extra cover
slow, loopy full toss now, from the back of the hand, can't do much with it, pushes to extra cover
shuffles across outside off and tucks it through midwicket
this one carries in with the angle, good length, Samuels plays it out down the pitch
superb delivery, angle in from wide of the crease and changes direction to swerve away from the right hander
right forward to a fullish delivery and pushes in front of mid off
deep midwicket has run in quickly to cut off the second after a short of a length ball is worked towards him
comes across and softly drops it close to the pitch on off, and the single is taken
late in getting forward to this pitched up ball, awkwardly jabs it away from close to the splice, there is lots of bounce here
there is width for the cut, and Samuels gets on top of the bounce too, but he's hit it straight to point
bowled full and on the stumps, 140 kph, says the speed gun, nudged to midwicket
into the pads first ball and he goes across to work it away, short fine dives to save the boundary

that is a steepler, and Mahmood has struck in his first over, Suman was going nowhere, he tried to lift this pitched up ball down the ground, ended up hitting high and straight down into the hands of mid off, who judged it to perfection
walks out, and softly runs it to short third for a quick run
stretches forward to defend a pitched up delivery down the pitch
stabs one on a length outside off to backward point for one
widish back of a length ball, opens the face to steer it behind point
stays in the crease to a pitched up ball outside off and tries to run it to third man, misses
gets some width but he is no position to play the cut, ends up guiding it weakly to point
super, holds its line from a good length, and beats the push from the crease, that wasn't far from off stump, and bounced as well
dribbles fine down leg off the pad
now Uthappa opens the face to a length ball around off, and runs it just past the lone slip
fine response from Suman, he fetches this length ball angled in and lifts it high over midwicket, one bounce over the rope

oh dear, what a miss, Piyush Chawla is is, running in from mid on, clear run out chance there, Uthappa was miles outside after running half way up the pitch, Suman had gone nowhere after mistiming a punch towards mid on, Chawla had all the time in the world, but his lob misses
straightening on the stumps, nudged in front of square leg
that will be the first boundary, Uthappa moves forward and flicks it in the air, but it doesn't matter as he's picked the gap to the right of mid on
in control with the run this time, pushed solidly in front of cover
confusion after a push towards mid on, but they get across for the single in the end
full and fast on the stumps, hits the pad, but there were clear two sounds there, looked like a big inside edge
bit of away shape, nicely carrying through to Gilchrist, as batsman shoulders arms
sharp bounce from back of a length, he is behind the line to defend
hit on the pads with a quick length ball, but that was headed down leg
into the pads now, and it is worked down to fine leg
leading edge right away, falls quite short of point, as Uthappa walks outs to a pitched up outside off
Pandey's tentativeness has consumed him, just shuffling across in the crease and prodding at a length ball around off, and he plays on
lovely, away shape and bounce, Pandey moves forward and holds the bat inside the line
bowled further up, Pandey is quite uncertain as he stumbles across and stabs it away
moves across on off and watches it swing away widish
pitches it further up, it moves away, Uthappa forward to run it to third man
gentle outswinger first up well outside off, left alone

they hold onto a catch, they do, Hussey backs away and slogs it to the right of midwicket, where Suman leaps and holds on to a stunner, but wait, they check the replays and it is too tight, way too tight, and ultimately umpire Taufel calls it a no-ball
swivels and gives this everything he has, but the ball only rolls towards slip
backs away to a pitched up ball and runs it to point
punched to short extra cover
comes down and swings it off the pad through square leg for a couple
appeal for lbw as he pushes to defend, inside edge though
flighted again, on leg, hit along the ground to long on
flighted full, and now Hussey gets forward to power it straight past the bowler
punched to covers
on a good length, and he casually hammers it over the bowler, this is Vohra;s evening, everything's coming off
they are dropping them all around, punched off the back foot, decent height to Taylor at slip, pops out, he turns back, tries reaching it, but it's too late
late in getting forward to this pitched up ball, nudges it to leg for one
walks out, opens the face to a length ball and steers it to point
bangs it in short, Hussey withdraws from the line
lovely delivery, good length, holds the line and beats the veteran outside off stump
slog-swept powerfully into the deep midwicket boundary, he's making the most of his opportunity, Vohra
drives a tossed up ball to backward point for one
Mandeep falls, skips out to a flighted ball, is nowhere near the pitch, tries to dab it away to off, inside edge onto stumps
skids on towards middle, he makes room and dabs it to point
moves inside the line to drive a flighted one, to extra cover
flat and sitting up, and he;s cracked it between the bowler and the non-striker, long on dives, in vain
and next ball, he has a go again at a full delivery, and this time it crashes into the deep midwicket boundary
dropped, slogged straight to mid on and pops right out, Dinda the man
turns a length ball from off to square leg
pushes in the air, it loops just over the reach of point
does not get hold of the pull, picks up a couple wide of deep midwicket
overpitchd, driven down to sweeper cover
short and quick, slapped away in the air to sweeper cover
flattish outside off, he times the punch to sweeper cover this time
chops it into the ground on the off side
moves outside off to scoop it to fine leg
that has bounced and straightened, he's been beaten as he looks to dab it
pitched up, swung away without a care, just short of Pandey running in and diving forward from deep midwicket, brave effort, he could have been smacked in the face,
works it off the stumps wide of mid on, where Nayar fumbles with the slide
back of a length, he pops it in the air towards square leg
opens the face and steers to third man past the slip
nearly in the blockhole, but he;s managed to squeeze it to through midwicket, almost falling over as he gets legs out of the way
slower length ball on the stumps, he pats it back
punches a length ball, cover is in the way
forward to push a length delivery to point, cannot get the run
slogs at a very full one, thick inside edge to short fine
drives a full delivery hard, down to mid off
moves across to nudge this off the pads, can;t connect
opens the face to keep the strike with a steer to third man
runs coming every ball, softly drops a length ball onto the off side and rushes across
into vacant spaces behind square leg, with a tickle off the pad, stopped just inside the rope
pulled away to deep midwicket
hello, he;s going after everything, bashes it past the bowler this time, this arrives quickly onto him from a length, he was probably looking at the pull, if he was, he's adjusted superbly
Gilchrist was talking about Vohra at the toss today, and so far, he's not put a foot wrong, shortish from Dinda, he swivels and pulls it high over square leg
third one, some width from back of a length, and he;s opened the face to carve it through point
successive fours, goes over short extra cover now, just over his jump, but he'd timed the punch quite well
full on the pads, and it is flicked in the air through midwicket, Rahul Sharma is rather clumsy as he chases and puts in the dive, but can't pull it back
turns a length ball wide of mid on
overpitched, he hasn;t timed this, but he;s got enough bat on it to loft it out of the reach of mid off
backs away outside leg and chops it down to third man
stabs at this length delivery outside off, and is beaten as it holds its line and bounces
steers a widish length ball to third man
gets behind the line to defend

and Gilchrist has picked that man on the deep square leg boundary, tries to swat this length ball to the fielder's right, but he's not timed it, and Samuels has to move in a few paces to take the catch
good length, not much pace to work with, and he pushes off the back foot to extra cover
good length, he is across to defend to the off side
he's pulled this past the non-striker, mid on's got no chance, opens up to a shortish one and ends up hitting from close to the toe end
spots some width on this pitched up ball and goes after it, thick edge flies down to third man
pushes across at a length delivery, off the inner part of the blade, to midwicket
back of a length, worked to square leg, where Samuels dives to take the pace off it
good length, but he sends it down leg now
pitched up on the stumps, Mandeep late in getting out to it, jabs it to off
not much of a forward push and he is beaten as he swings at one leaving him with the angle just outside off
he is back, and he is looking in fearsome touch, on the pads and Gilchrist takes us years back with a flick into the deep square leg crowd, what timing, what class
blasted down the ground, overpitched from Bhuvneshwar, no swing, and Gilchrist has gone high over mid off
he is hitting them crisply, another push fairly races to mid off
good length across and outside off, pushed to covers
and first ball, Gilchrist drills a full delivery straight down the ground, it was on off, but didn't swing
